name: WF-363 — Seller Response Event → AI Classification & Negotiation Routing Controller

parameters.jsCode: const i=$input.first().json||{};const now=new Date().toISOString();const dealId=i.deal_id||i.dealId;const leadId=i.lead_id||i.leadId;const propertyId=i.property_id||i.propertyId;const text=String(i.seller_response||i.inbound_message||i.response_text||'').trim();const dnc=Boolean(i.dnc||i.do_not_contact);const blockers=Array.isArray(i.blockers)?i.blockers:[];const attempts=Number(i.attempts||0);const maxAttempts=Number(i.max_attempts||5);let classification='unknown',route='human_control',reason='unclassified';const lower=text.toLowerCase();if(dnc){classification='dnc';reason='do_not_contact';}else if(blockers.length){classification='blocked';reason='deal_blocker';}else if(!dealId||!leadId||!propertyId||!text){classification='invalid';reason='missing_required_response_context';route='reconciliation';}else if(/\b(no|not interested|stop|remove me|dont contact|do not contact)\b/i.test(lower)){classification='rejection_or_optout';reason='negative_response';route='reengagement_or_close';}else if(/\b(yes|interested|sounds good|let.?s do it|accept|agreed|okay)\b/i.test(lower)){classification='positive';reason='seller_interest';route='negotiation';}else if(/\b(counter|higher|lower|price|offer|\$|cash|can you do)\b/i.test(lower)){classification='counteroffer';reason='pricing_negotiation';route='negotiation';}else if(/\b(call|phone|talk|when can|available)\b/i.test(lower)){classification='call_request';reason='seller_wants_contact';route='human_or_negotiation';}else{classification='question_or_neutral';reason='needs_ai_review';route='negotiation';}const key=(i.event_idempotency_key||[dealId,leadId,propertyId,text].filter(Boolean).join(':'))+':ai-classification';return[{json:{...i,workflow_id:'WF-363',status:'classified',classification,route,reason,deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,seller_response:text,ai_classification:{label:classification,reason,confidence:classification==='unknown'?'low':'medium'},event_idempotency_key:key,processed_at:now,crm_activity:{type:'seller_response_ai_classification',workflow_id:'WF-363',classification,route,reason}}}];
